maya: Heads up 1: All-hands tomorrow 10:00 PT. Short format (25m). Drop any Qs here or in the Q&A doc.

maya: Agenda (25m):
- 10:0010:05 Exec update  strategy + hiring priorities
- 10:0510:12 Product demo  Dedicated autoscale improvements
- 10:1210:18 Policy & ops  data retention default + runbook tweak
- 10:1810:25 Live Q&A

maya: Q&A doc (please upvote): https://docs.google.com/redwood-allhands-qna

jon: Can we include a one-line blurb about the runbook change? small ops change but might be visible to some teams.

maya: Yes, well fold it into policy & ops. @jon paste the wording here when youready.

jon: TL;DR: runbook now auto-escalates to oncall + SRE lead after 3 failed retries and runs a pre-flight healthcheck; updated tests added.

srini: Note: changing the default debug log retention to 90 days. Projects can opt out via project settings > data retention. Migration guide added to the Q&A doc.

maya: @srini please attach the migration checklist and the curl snippet to export logs into the doc before the meeting.

srini: Done. Added checklist and sample curl: ```curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/export -d '{"project":"acme","range":"30d"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>'```

olivia: Reminder for managers: if you need headcount, put requests into the hiring tracker by EOD today. We'll surface requests in the last 2 minutes.

kate: For APAC folks: we'll upload slides + recording immediately and run a follow-up office hours at 16:00 SGT to answer region-specific Qs.

all-hands-bot: Reminder posted to calendar: All-hands  Product + Policy update  Tomorrow 10:00 PT (link in #general).

recording-bot: Recording uploaded: https://records.redwood.co/meetings/1832001111-allhands-april.mp4 (slides: https://slides.redwood.co/allhands/1832001111)

maya: Post-meeting notes (short):
- Exec: reiterated reliability-first for next quarter; approved +3 infra hires.
- Product: Dedicated autoscale reduced 99th percentile tail latency by ~18% in internal tests.
- Policy/Ops: default retention switched to 90 days; opt-out path documented; migration guide live. Runbook escalation tweak deployed; weekly runbook tests scheduled.

maya: If your question in the Q&A doc wasn't answered live we'll follow up in-thread and update the public notes. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
